entry.title: Cow Creek Umpqua Tribe Receives $4.9 Million Grant for New Housing
entry.summary: The Cow Creek Umpqua Tribe has received a $4.9 million federal grant to build seven single-family homes in Myrtle Creek. The Tribe has also broken ground on a four-plex expected to open to Tribal families in early 2028.

entry.title: Roseburg Warms Into the 80s This Week as Dry Weather Returns
entry.summary: Roseburg will warm steadily this week, with mostly sunny skies and highs climbing from the mid-70s Monday and Tuesday into the mid-80s by Friday. Isolated thunderstorms are possible elsewhere in the region Wednesday and Thursday.

entry.title: Riddle Elementary to Reopen Monday After Bat Activity Cleared

entry.title: Roseburg Council Agenda Includes Disposal Rate Request, Stewart Park Plan And Homelessness Report
